Name: Malchus
Summary: Malchus was the high priest's servant whose right ear Peter cut off with a sword in Gethsemane. Jesus healed the wound, rebuking the sword and the arrest.
KeyStory: Malchus came to arrest Jesus and left healed by Him, the last miracle before the cross.
LifeLesson: Jesus healed the man who came to arrest Him. His mercy reaches the very hands raised against Him.
